newsitem.title: EGYPT: Sony Broadcast, Kvaerner win Egyptian contract.
newsitem.headline: Sony Broadcast, Kvaerner win Egyptian contract.

text.p: A British-based consortium including Sony Broadcast and Professional and Kvaerner Construction has won a big contract to build a television production complex in Egypt, industry sources said on Monday.
The contract, which has been under negotiation since October, is expected to be worth more than $300 million.

The client is the government's Egyptian Radio and Television Union and the television studios are part of a massive project dubbed "Hollywood on the Nile" in Sixth of October City, a satellite city in the desert 30 km (20 miles) west of Cairo.
The sources said the consortium would sign the contract in Cairo on Tuesday evening. More details were not available.
